name: docs
title: Docs
description: A reference manual. Serif text with numbered sections, notes and warnings in the margin beside the paragraph they belong to, code with a rule and a language label, the contents and the page outline together on the left, search in the masthead. Neutral starter pages; the Kestrel example shows it finished. No plugins.
features: Contents from SMGen's tree menu, with the page outline beneath it
Numbered sections and subsections, matched in the outline
Note, tip and warning fenced divs set as margin notes on wide screens
Code blocks with a left rule and a language label
Self-hosted Source Serif 4 and IBM Plex Mono, preloaded
Search through smgen-search when it is installed
Edition and version in the masthead, edit link at the foot
System light and dark with a toggle

sampleContent.purpose: Getting started: what the first page should do
Install and configuration pages with a keys table
Two groups in the contents, with .fm.yaml for title and order
Short pages; about says this is a starter
A finished manual built on this template

notes: Set DOCS_VERSION and DOCS_REPOSITORY in .smgen.yaml for the masthead edition and edit links
Search needs the smgen-search package on the build machine; the theme hides the box when it is not
